# 04 — Current Execution Sequence — Owner-Approved Direction

**Decision date:** 2026-08-05

## Strategic direction

Do not begin the full Financial Stream site redesign yet. Complete a small, high-value first wave, then pause major sitewide work until the ProAI Expert website is finished.

## Recommended sequence

### Step 1 — Complete the two RU/EN flagship articles

Use the two flagship articles to establish the new editorial standard for Financial Stream:

- research and factual quality;
- language-specific EN/RU intent;
- premium editorial layout;
- source and evidence treatment;
- internal-link logic;
- conversion CTA pattern;
- mobile and accessibility QA.

These pages should define the future article system, but they should not automatically become the visual template for every service or company page.

### Step 2 — Create a new About / Trust page in EN and RU

Create a premium, human, company-first About page using the approved owner photograph.

Recommended page role:

- introduce the owner and the business without turning the page into a résumé;
- explain why Financial Stream exists and how it helps clients;
- show the working approach and communication style;
- reinforce the six valid service areas without ranking one service above the others;
- explain EN/RU support and remote U.S. service boundaries accurately;
- use only verified metrics, testimonials, credentials and experience claims;
- end with a structured-request CTA.

Because the production site is bilingual, the About system should launch as a coordinated EN/RU pair rather than a single-language page.

### Step 3 — Apply only small safety and quality fixes needed around this release

Do not open a broad redesign program. Limit adjacent work to low-risk changes required for the new pages and obvious defects, including:

- fixing the RU mobile-menu accessible name;
- adding or validating skip navigation;
- adding About links to the EN/RU navigation and footer;
- updating sitemap, canonical and hreflang mappings for the About pair;
- verifying mobile layout, broken links and form/CTA routes;
- preserving all six peer services, including Payroll / L&I;
- keeping Financial Consulting / Document Review combined.

### Step 4 — Pause broad Financial Stream redesign

After the two flagship articles and About EN/RU are approved and live, freeze major Financial Stream redesign work while the ProAI Expert website is completed.

During the pause:

- keep current production URLs;
- do not mass-rewrite or delete older articles;
- do not change the six-service architecture;
- collect Search Console, analytics, backlink and conversion evidence for the later redesign.

### Step 5 — Return for the full sitewide redesign

Use the completed flagship articles and About page as two separate reference systems:

- flagship articles define the editorial/content system;
- About defines the trust, human and company-story system.

Then redesign the homepage, services, contact/start-here, navigation, reusable templates and remaining content as one evidence-led program.

## Why this sequence is recommended

This sequence creates visible quality gains without forcing a premature sitewide rebuild. It produces three strong reference surfaces, improves trust and editorial authority, avoids unnecessary interruption to ProAI Expert, and gives the later redesign clearer standards and better evidence.

## Guardrails

- Payroll / L&I remains a normal active peer service; do not remove, hide, demote or automatically place it first.
- Financial Consulting / Document Review remains a combined complementary service.
- Do not invent credentials, years of experience, client counts, outcomes, ratings or guarantees.
- Do not modify `main` directly; use isolated branches and owner-reviewed pull requests for implementation.
